messages:
samir: Quick note: PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/6128 is blocked on the RFC linked below. Need arch/design sign-off before we can merge (kv-cache sharding change).
lia: Got it. Can you give a 2-line summary of the user-visible changes?
maria: Summary: we change the prefix->shard mapping and add an optional shard_id header to inter-service RPCs. If Dedicated customers don't rollout the proxy + cache together, lookups can miss.
samir: Exactly. RFC: https://go.redwood/rfcs/2026-04-kv-cache-sharding
vaibhav: For SRE, can you paste the canary steps and the CLI we'll run? Need to add to runbook.
samir: Canary steps in PR description; copying here:
1) enable feature flag on 5% of traffic for the cache service
2) monitor hit-rate / latency for 24h
3) bump to 25% and run cache backfill/invalidations
4) full rollout
Command example: `./ops/rollout.sh --service cache --flag new_shard --pct 5`
lia: Please add a clear API compatibility section in both RFC and PR. I can't sign off without that. State behavior when header is absent and the fallback semantics.
samir: Will add. Also included a canary rollback plan in the PR.
maria: I'll read the RFC in depth and post comments. Planning a quick pass after stand.
alex: Product constraint: tokenization/response shape must be identical. Acceptance: <1% failure rate increase, <5ms p99 latency uplift allowed.
lia: Also add a note for Dedicated customers: we need a coordinated deploy window or automated proxy version check.
samir: Added a compatibility table and a Dedicated rollout note in the RFC and PR description.
lia: Reviewing now. If the compatibility table is clear I'll +1.
vaibhav: SRE reviewed the runbook, added steps to ops/runbooks/cache-shard.md (including post-mortem checklist and metric dashboards).
maria: Left a small wording nit in the RFC but overall LG. No architectural objections from my side.
samir: Thanks. Waiting for 2 approvals (lia + maria) and CI to pass; will hold 20min before merging to give time for last objections.
deploy-bot: PR 6128 status: gated_on_rfc. Notifying when gating cleared.
lia: +1 (pending CI). Good to merge after green.
maria: +1
samir: CI is green, merging in 10. Thanks everyone :rocket: 
samir: merged.
